title: Smallest Rotation with Highest Score
description: Find the rotation k that maximizes the score of an array, where the score is sum(nums[i] <= i after rotation).
pseudocode:
1: let n = nums.length
2: let diff = new Array(n).fill(0)
3: for i from 0 to n-1:
4:   let low = (i - nums[i] + 1 + n) % n
5:   let high = i
6:   diff[low]++, diff[(high + 1) % n]--
7: let maxScore = -1, bestK = 0, curr = 0
8: for k from 0 to n-1:
9:   curr += diff[k]
10:  if curr > maxScore: maxScore = curr, bestK = k

steps.note: Initialize difference array to track score changes
Update diff array for i=0: low=(0-2+1+3)%3=2, high=0
Update diff array for i=1: low=(1-3+1+3)%3=2, high=1
Calculating prefix sums to find best rotation k
